lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Joice Lopes Leite | Lesson 5 -- Where Things Are
lesson.grammar_point: prepositions of place (in / on / at / next to / between / near)

listenings.text: Good morning, and welcome to the conference. Here is some information about the building. The registration desk is on the first floor, next to the main entrance. The big room is on the second floor. Room three and room four are on the third floor, between the elevator and the coffee area. The coffee is free all day. If you are lost, please look for a person with a blue shirt. We are here to help you. Thank you, and have a very good day.

Hello, this is a message about your session tomorrow. Your session is in room four, on the third floor, at two in the afternoon. Please arrive at half past one. The technical team is in the room from one o'clock. Your name is on the door. If you need water, there is a small table near the window. See you tomorrow, and thank you very much.

extra_audio.text: Joice arrives at the conference building. She looks for the registration desk near the entrance. She takes her badge and asks where her room is. She goes to the third floor. She finds room four, between the elevator and the coffee area.
